lines.text: The root is Fact! Affect, defect.
Did you know? Fact is Latin for make or do.
Affect: toward plus make or do.
Defect: down plus make or do.
Quick quiz! Which means down plus make or do?
Defect! Down plus make or do.

words.ex: Lack of sleep can affect your concentration.
Inspectors found a defect in the wiring of several units.
